reason: The passage explicitly describes how Pharaoh and the Egyptian ruling authorities enslave the children of Israel and make their lives bitter through hard labor. The text states 'And the Egyptians enslaved the children of Israel with hard labor' (וַיַּעֲבִדוּ מִצְרַיִם אֶת־ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּפָֽרֶךְ) and 'And they made their lives bitter with hard work' (וַיְמָרְר֨וּ אֶת־ חַיֵּיהֶ֜ם בַּעֲבֹדָ֣ה קָשָׁ֗ה). The political elite (Pharaoh and his officials) systematically oppress the regular people (Israelite laborers).
